$comment: English display measures: values divided to millions (M) or thousands (K) in the expression, unit letter in the format string. Format-string scaling (#,0.0,,) does not work in Power BI Desktop 2.157 — it rendered '110,558,285.0,,M' (Desktop capture). Same measure names as measures.ko.json, so specs never change per language.

measures.YoY Text: VAR r = [전년 대비 증감률] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( r ), "YoY " & FORMAT ( r, "▲0.0%;▼0.0%;0.0%" ) )
measures.Profit YoY Text: VAR r = [이익 증감률] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( r ), "YoY " & FORMAT ( r, "▲0.0%;▼0.0%;0.0%" ) )
measures.Target Gap Text: VAR d = [목표 대비 차이] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( d ), "vs target " & FORMAT ( d / 1000000, "▲#,0.0;▼#,0.0;0" ) & "M" )
measures.AOV YoY Text: VAR r = [AOV YoY %] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( r ), "YoY " & FORMAT ( r, "▲0.0%;▼0.0%;0.0%" ) )
measures.Margin YoY Text: VAR d = [Margin YoY pp] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( d ), "YoY " & FORMAT ( d * 100, "▲0.0;▼0.0;0.0" ) & "pp" )
measures.Orders YoY Text: VAR r = [Orders YoY %] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( r ), "YoY " & FORMAT ( r, "▲0.0%;▼0.0%;0.0%" ) )
measures.Context Label: VAR y = SELECTEDVALUE ( '날짜'[연도] ) VAR last = CALCULATE ( MAX ( '판매'[주문일자] ) ) VAR ch = IF ( ISFILTERED ( '매장'[채널] ), CONCATENATEX ( VALUES ( '매장'[채널] ), '매장'[채널], " + " ), "All channels" ) RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( y ), "All years", y & "  ·  Jan–" & FORMAT ( last, "MMM", "en-US" ) ) & "  ·  " & ch
measures.Headline Stores: VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( '매장'[매장명] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [전년 대비 증감률] ) ) VAR lo = TOPN ( 1, t, [전년 대비 증감률], ASC ) RETURN "Stores down YoY: " & COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( t, [전년 대비 증감률] < 0 ) ) & " of " & COUNTROWS ( t ) & "  ·  Largest drop: " & CONCATENATEX ( lo, '매장'[매장명], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MINX ( lo, [전년 대비 증감률] ), "▲0.0%;▼0.0%" )
